pairs.difference: A is the same lighthouse as the REAL lesson card: a slim tapering tower, a thin-railed gallery and a fine spire. B is a stone house with a tower. Its walls are a swollen block with soft rounded corners at the base plinth. The cone turret and chimney are chunky stubs, the roof eaves are thick and blunt, and the windows read as puffy inset pillows.
pairs.fix: Draw the house walls as flat planes with crisp, tight corners. Give it a thin roof edge with a sharp eave overhang and a slender chimney, and keep the base step a thin flat slab, not a rounded cushion.

pairs.difference: A is a seahorse with a frilled back ridge and a tight curled tail, and its spines read naturally. B is a balloon bunch: round balloons with thin knotted strings. The strings stay thin, as they should. Neither card has a clear shape flaw that matches the lessons.

A shows boxing gloves, which are naturally puffy, with a cuff and thumb in the right relation. B is a cauldron: a squat swollen pot with stubby cylinder legs ending in rounded pucks. The loop handles are thick tubes, and the rim is a fat rounded ring. Every part is inflated like a toy.
pairs.fix: Draw the cauldron's iron rim as a thin lip. Make the ring handles thin wire loops and the three legs short, tapered cast-iron feet, not round pegs. Keep the pot belly slightly flattened, not balloon-round.

pairs.difference: A is a spring rider duck: a coiled spring, a flat base plate with straight edges, and a separate handle peg. Its parts are distinct and correctly related. B is a jack-o'-lantern swollen into an almost perfect oval blob, with solidity 0.971, above the real range. Its ribs don't break the outline and the stem is a short stub.
pairs.fix: Draw the pumpkin with deeper ribbed lobes that notch the outline. Make it slightly lopsided with a flatter top around the stem, and give it a longer, twisted, thin stem.

pairs.difference: A is a tiered fountain. Its bowls are thin flat discs on narrow pedestals with crisp rims, and the basin has a straight low wall. B is a black cat whose body is a single smooth bean. Its legs are fused into stubby lumps at the base, the head merges into the body, and the collar is a fat sausage ring.
pairs.fix: Draw the cat with separate slim front legs and visible paws. Give it a defined neck and chest, a thin tail, and a thin flat collar strap.

pairs.difference: A shows sneakers with layered soles and laces; the parts are plausible. B is a tombstone. Its slab front is mostly flat, but the top edge has a soft pillowy dome with a blobby lump of moss on the silhouette. The crack notch is chunky, and the base plinth has rounded, soft corners instead of cut-stone bevels.
pairs.fix: Draw the headstone as a flat cut-stone slab with a crisp arched top and tight beveled edges. Make the base a flat rectangular block with sharp corners and the crack a thin jagged line.

pairs.difference: B is a graduation cap: a thin flat board with crisp corners, a skull cap and a thin tassel cord, all in the right parts. A is a witch hat. Its brim is a thick, smooth oval disc with a rounded edge, and the cone is a smooth, curved horn. The band is a fat ring with a toy-like buckle, and the outline is reduced to two simple blobs.
pairs.fix: Draw the witch hat brim thin and slightly wavy with a crisp edge. Make the cone crumpled and creased with a bent tip, and the band a thin flat strap with a small buckle.

pairs.difference: B is an oil lamp: a glass chimney, a burner collar, a thin loop handle and a footed base, all in proportion. A is a candelabra. Its arms are thick, smooth U-tubes, and its candles are fat equal-width cylinders. The drip pans are puffy discs, and the base is a swollen dome. Solidity of 0.398 sits below the real range.
pairs.fix: Draw the candelabra arms as thin, elegant curved rods with small sharp-edged drip cups. Use slimmer tapered candles and a flat stepped base with crisp rims.

pairs.difference: A is a stone chess table: a flat slab top with a straight run, and stools. It reads as real. B is a coffin whose outline is one convex hexagon blob with solidity 0.988, above the real max of 0.932. Its edges are soft and rounded, the lid is a thick swollen board, and the cross is a chunky inflated bar.
pairs.fix: Draw the coffin lid as a flat plank board with crisp beveled edges and a visible thin gap at the lid seam. Make the cross thin and flat.

pairs.difference: A is a glass with a straw and a paper umbrella. The straw is thin with a bend, the glass walls are straight and the umbrella has notched edges, so its thin parts stay thin. B is a crystal ball: a perfect round blob on a swollen dome base. The stand prongs are thick rods with ball tips, and the base rings are puffy.
pairs.fix: Draw the crystal ball stand as a thin ornate claw or three slender prongs gripping the sphere. Make the base flat and stepped with crisp rims.

pairs.difference: B is a neckerchief whose fabric folds and knot are plausible. A is a broom: a smooth, uniformly thick handle ending in a ball cap and a short, puffy bristle head with a rounded bottom. The binding is a fat ring, and solidity of 0.526 sits below the real range.
pairs.fix: Draw the broom with a thinner, slightly knobbly stick and a longer straw head that flares out. Make the bristle ends ragged and splayed, tied with thin twine.

pairs.difference: A shows flip-flops: flat soles with rounded toes and thin Y-straps, plausible. B shows stacked books with flat boards, square spines and slightly protruding covers, also plausible. Neither shows the inflated or extra-part pattern from the lessons.

pattern: Generated cards draw objects as inflated toys. Iron, wood and stone are swollen into smooth, convex blobs with soft rounded corners, which shows up as solidity near or above the real maximum (coffin, pumpkin). Parts that should be thin, like candelabra arms, cauldron handles and legs, broom sticks, hat brims and cat legs, are thickened into tubes or fused away. Outlines are simplified, with no creases, notches or ragged edges. The lessons also show generated cards adding extra parts (an island base, lugs, more webbing) and fitting the whole object as a compact chunk.
